```release-note
Support nested image paths when using `podman kube play --build`.
```

## Description

Fixes: #28418

Support nested image paths with `podman kube play --build`.

Previously, `imageNamePrefix()` only used the image name without its parent path, so an image such as `mocks/service-a:latest` would only look for `service-a/Containerfile`.

This change keeps the existing lookup behavior for backward compatibility and falls back to the nested image path when the simple image path is not found.

### Added tests covering:
 
-  Simple image names
-  Nested image paths
-  Backward compatibility 
-  Fallback behavior
-  Nested image with registry and port
-  Nested image with digest
